steps.script: (function(){try{var s=window.sources;if(s&&s[0]&&s[0].file)return s[0].file;var v=document.querySelector('video source,video');if(v&&v.src)return v.src;if(window.jwplayer){var p=window.jwplayer().getPlaylistItem();if(p&&p.file)return p.file;}var e=performance.getEntriesByType('resource');for(var i=e.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(/\.(m3u8|mp4)(\?|$)/.test(e[i].name))return e[i].name;}}catch(x){}return '';})()
